item.description:
0.10.0

Korean now fills the cell it is given.

  • A Korean monospace font ships with the app. A terminal gives each Hangul syllable two columns; Menlo has no Hangul, and the substitute only filled 72% of that space, so Korean came out visibly gapped. D2Coding fills all of it.
  • It is registered for PortButler only — nothing is added to your Font Book. It becomes the default only if you read PortButler in Korean and have never picked a font yourself.
  • A new version is announced in one place — the version line at the bottom of the session list, which now reads Update available · 0.9.0 → 0.10.0. It no longer prints a line into your terminal.
  • Settings fits each tab instead of stretching every tab to the tallest one and spreading the spare height between the rows.
  • The serial transfer pane lines up on the left, and three strings that stayed English in Korean mode are translated.
